Warm ivory textured, crisp dark ink contours with physically believable rich shaded materials: weathered grey-black basalt, warm plaster storefronts, red terracotta tile roofs, woven linen, basket fibers, timber grain, iron rims. NOT flat vector, not photoreal human. Ancient Roman Pompeii before destruction. NO text, labels, numbers, arrows, panels, watermarks, explosion, racing chariots or modern stuff.
Maintain same adult woman, dark brown hair in a simple bun, muted terracotta draped dress over cream linen, brown Roman leather sandals, woven basket. Same timber two-wheel one-axle goods cart with short logs, iron-rimmed spoked wheels, guided by one adult man in cream knee-length tunic; no horses required in these illustrative reconstructions.
Street is paved in irregular polygonal dark basalt, with sidewalks higher on both sides. Across the street is a row of THREE separated rounded oblong basalt stepping stones: each long axis runs ALONG the road; top roughly level with the sidewalk; two interior gaps clear for cart wheels. These are low step blocks, not gigantic boulders. Shallow water below stone tops, not river.

native_geometry.units: Illustrative model units, not excavation measurements
